text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takarazuka Kinen, Gold City 
called out to Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked once more by Tamamo Cross why 
she runs, Gold City replies that she 
doesn't have an answer—she just wants to 
run and win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was more than enough. Brimming with 
fierce spirit, Gold City headed toward the 
race...!
